Recap · Under the hood

Copilot Chat or Microsoft 365 Copilot?

One experience, four capabilities. Switch View as between Copilot Chat (Basic, what Business Consultants have today) and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) to see what changes, then compare an answer with and without Work IQ.

or select a capabilityView as
Natural language
Enterprise data protectionCopilot Chat & Microsoft 365 Copilot
Ask in your own words|
Enterprise data protection — your data stays yours.

Signed in with a work account, Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) are covered by enterprise data protection: prompts and responses get the same contractual commitments as your email in Exchange and files in SharePoint. Copilot runs inside the Microsoft 365 service boundary, honours permissions, sensitivity labels, retention and audit, and only surfaces what each person is already allowed to see.

Large language models

Copilot draws on frontier GPT models from OpenAI. By default it routes each prompt automatically — Auto, Quick response or Think deeper — so people get a fast answer or deeper reasoning without choosing a model themselves. Model names shown are examples from Microsoft's published model list; availability varies by Copilot experience and admin settings. Prompts, responses and work data accessed through Microsoft Graph aren't used to train the foundation models.

Your work · Work IQ

With Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium), Work IQ grounds answers in your work, within each person's existing permissions. Copilot Chat (Basic) works with the web and the files you attach.

“Apa yang harus saya prioritaskan sebelum account review hari Jumat?”
Contoh fiktif

Untuk persiapan account review: periksa armada dan kontrak pelanggan, tinjau peluang yang masih terbuka, antisipasi keberatan, dan selaraskan dengan Sales Manager.

Umum — Copilot tidak mengetahui rapat, email, atau file Anda.

Tiga hal yang perlu Anda tindak lanjuti sebelum Jumat:

  1. PT Contoso Mining Nusantara meminta estimasi pengiriman untuk ±10 dump truck — Bima berjanji mengonfirmasi slot paling lambat 27 Nov. 1
  2. RFQ tender armada 2027 dari PT Litware segera ditutup dan belum ada PIC. 2
  3. Sales Manager meminta draft pitch manajemen sebelum review 4 Des. 3
1 Rapat Teams · Account review 20 Nov2 Email · Procurement Litware3 Chat · Dewi
Microsoft 365 apps

Premium brings Copilot into Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams. Copilot Chat (Basic) can work with content open in Outlook and Teams.

The live web

Web grounding keeps answers current. Search queries sent to Bing are stripped of user and tenant identifiers and aren't used to train the models.

Where to access it — three front doors

Two doors are open to everyone who signs in with a work account. The third — Copilot working inside your documents — depends on your licence.

New name: Microsoft 365 Copilot is now called Microsoft Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now Microsoft Copilot Chat. The web address is moving to copilot.cloud.microsoft.
1 · Web browser

Go to copilot.cloud.microsoft in any browser — or select the Copilot icon in Microsoft Edge — sign in with your work account and start chatting. Nothing to install.

The Microsoft Copilot app on Windows, macOS, iPhone and Android — and Copilot Chat pinned in Teams and Outlook.

Copilot Chat · BasicMicrosoft 365 Copilot · Premium

Copilot directly in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and OneNote — working on the file in front of you.

Microsoft 365 Copilot · Premium — full experienceStandard access without the add-on varies by licence
Which one should I use? Start in the browser or the Copilot app for chatting, catching up and asking questions across your work — both are available when you sign in with your work account. Use Copilot inside the Office apps when you want to act on the document, spreadsheet or deck you are working on — the full experience comes with Microsoft Copilot (Premium).
Beyond Premium: Copilot Cowork needs a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence plus usage-based billing (Part 4). For Copilot Chat users, agents on shared company data (SharePoint, connectors) can be enabled by IT with pay-as-you-go. TEMPLATE AGENT

Prompt Coach: write, analyse and fix prompts

Template agent dari Microsoft yang membantu pengguna baru menyusun prompt yang terstruktur, memberi masukan, memeriksa kesesuaian dengan pedoman Responsible AI, dan memberikan contoh. Dibuat dengan Agent Builder — hanya berisi instruksi, sehingga cocok untuk Copilot Chat.

Cara menemukanAgents → All agents → cari “Prompt Coach” → Add (jika diizinkan tim IT Anda), atau buat dari template di Agent Builder
Paling cocok untukMembuat, menganalisis, dan memperbaiki prompt, serta memberi contoh — satu pertanyaan setiap kali
Prompt BC
Perbaiki prompt ini supaya hasilnya lebih spesifik untuk Business Consultant alat berat: "Buatkan ringkasan tentang PT Fabrikam Nikel Sulawesi."
Yang dilakukan Prompt Coach
  • Menanyakan goal, context, source, dan expectations yang belum ada
  • Memberikan prompt yang sudah diperbaiki dan dapat dipakai ulang setiap minggu

Tips: tempelkan prompt yang biasa Anda pakai sebelum kunjungan customer, lalu jawab pertanyaan Prompt Coach satu per satu.

Try COPILOT CHAT · YOU CAN DO THIS
TEMPLATE AGENT

Learning Coach: learn, practise, get quizzed

Template agent dari Microsoft yang menguraikan topik yang rumit menjadi ringkasan tingkat sederhana, menengah, dan detail; menyusun rencana belajar; serta memberi latihan dan kuis. Dibuat dengan Agent Builder dan hanya berisi instruksi, sehingga cocok untuk Copilot Chat.

Cara menemukanAgents → All agents → cari “Learning Coach” → Add (jika diizinkan tim IT Anda), atau buat dari template di Agent Builder
Paling cocok untukMemahami kerangka kerja baru, menyusun rencana belajar, latihan, dan persiapan tes — satu pertanyaan setiap kali
Bedanya dengan Prompt CoachPrompt Coach memperbaiki cara Anda bertanya; Learning Coach membantu Anda menguasai topiknya
1 · Pahami kerangka kerja
Ajari saya Key Intelligence Questions (KIQ) untuk market intelligence penjualan alat berat dalam 3 tingkat: sederhana, menengah, dan detail. Setelah itu berikan 3 contoh KIQ untuk sektor tambang nikel.
2 · Uji pemahaman
Beri saya kuis 5 pertanyaan tentang analisis SWOT dan battlecard kompetitor untuk Business Consultant alat berat. Ajukan satu pertanyaan setiap kali, tunggu jawaban saya, lalu jelaskan jawaban yang benar.
3 · Rencana belajar
Susun rencana belajar 2 minggu, 15 menit per hari, agar saya mampu membuat competitive analysis dan opportunity scoring sendiri. Sertakan latihan harian yang memakai data fiktif.
Yang dilakukan Learning Coach
  • Menjelaskan bertahap — dari sederhana ke detail
  • Memberi kuis dan umpan balik atas jawaban Anda
  • Menyusun rencana belajar yang realistis

Template lain yang serupa: Writing Coach (masukan atas kejelasan dan nada tulisan). Learning agent dengan role-play coaching memerlukan lisensi Microsoft Copilot.

REASONING AGENT

Researcher: a researched, cited report

Menangani riset kompleks dan bertahap. Researcher menyusun rencana, menelusuri konten kerja dan web, lalu menulis laporan terstruktur lengkap dengan sitasi — prosesnya memang lebih lama daripada chat biasa.

Use it forBriefings, comparisons, “what changed”, preparing for a decision or a customer meeting
How it worksMay ask clarifying questions, then researches files, emails, meetings and chats you can access — plus the web if your admin allows it
Good to knowSimple requests take under 5 minutes, complex ones 10–45 minutes · up to 25 Researcher queries per user per month · not trained on your data
Use Analyst insteadWhen the answer is inside a spreadsheet
Prompt BC
Saya Business Consultant alat berat untuk sektor tambang batu bara dan nikel di Kalimantan dan Sulawesi. Susun market intelligence brief untuk 6-12 bulan ke depan: (1) sinyal permintaan alat berat dari berita, kebijakan dan laporan publik, (2) implikasinya untuk peluang replacement dan expansion, (3) 5 Key Intelligence Questions yang harus saya validasi ke customer. Sertakan sumber dan tanggal untuk setiap poin, dan tandai mana yang masih asumsi.
Yang Anda dapatkan
  • Sinyal permintaan, masing-masing dengan penerbit, tanggal, dan tautan
  • Implikasi untuk peluang replacement dan expansion
  • Key Intelligence Questions untuk divalidasi ke pelanggan

Buka setiap sitasi sebelum memakai angkanya. Hari ini presenter menampilkan hasil yang sudah disiapkan sebelumnya — Researcher dapat memerlukan beberapa menit.

Watch MICROSOFT 365 COPILOT · PRESENTER DEMO

Use it forTrends, comparisons, outliers, forecasts and charts

Part 2 · What you will see

The Configure page — Basic vs Premium

Same page for everyone, fewer sections for Copilot Chat users. Switch the view to see what changes before you start building.

Your view today. Instructions, public websites as knowledge, the built-in capabilities and suggested prompts. Work content (files, Outlook, Teams, connectors) is not part of a Basic agent — attach your file in the chat instead.

SharePoint, uploaded files and connectors can be enabled with pay-as-you-go by IT; email, people and Teams need a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.

Premium view. Adds Work content — cloud files, Outlook, Teams and Copilot connectors, each with its own switch — plus uploaded files (up to 20). This is the Work IQ half of an agent.

Describe
Buat agent bernama "BC Market Intel Coach" untuk Business Consultant alat berat. Agent memandu 5 langkah: (1) validasi data dan sinyal pasar, (2) peta peluang retain/expand dan kompetisi, (3) scoring dan pilih 3-5 peluang prioritas, (4) SWOT, winning strategy dan rencana 30-60-90 hari, (5) outline pitch untuk Sales Management. Selalu minta pengguna melampirkan file datanya, jangan menebak angka, pisahkan fakta dan asumsi, dan jawab dalam Bahasa Indonesia. Jangan memberi rekomendasi harga atau diskon.

INSTRUCT

Instructions that make the agent reliable

Peran, aturan, langkah, dan format — mengikuti panduan Microsoft untuk instruksi declarative agent. Tempelkan ke Configure → Instructions.

Instructions
# Peran
Kamu adalah BC Market Intel Coach untuk Business Consultant (BC) alat berat. Kamu membantu BC menyusun market intelligence dan winning strategy. BC yang mengambil keputusan.

# Aturan
- Gunakan hanya file yang dilampirkan pengguna dan situs publik yang dikonfigurasi. Jika file belum dilampirkan, minta file terlebih dahulu.
- Jangan menebak angka. Jika data kosong atau berstatus "To verify", tulis "perlu dicek".
- Pisahkan "Fakta (dengan sumber)" dan "Asumsi / saran".
- Jangan memberi rekomendasi harga, diskon, atau persetujuan kredit. Jangan menilai individu.

# Langkah
1. Validasi data: kolom kosong, status validasi, engagement terakhir lebih dari 90 hari.
2. Sinyal: buying signal dengan sumber dan tanggal; kelompokkan menjadi Retain atau Expand.
3. Kompetisi: win/loss dan alasan kalah per kompetitor bila file deal dilampirkan.
4. Scoring: pakai bobot yang diberikan pengguna; jika tidak ada, tanyakan.
5. Strategi: SWOT, value proposition, stakeholder, rencana 30-60-90 hari dengan PIC dan tanggal.

# Format
Tabel untuk data, maksimal 6 bullet per bagian, Bahasa Indonesia. Akhiri dengan daftar "Perlu dicek".
Try COPILOT CHAT · YOU CAN DO THIS

Setelah Create, agent hanya dapat diakses oleh Anda. Bagikan (Can chat) kepada rekan kerja setelah agent lolos pengujian.

Package a procedure you repeat as a skill and attach it to the agent: Configure → Skills → Add → upload ut-bc-pitch-deck.zip (SKILL.md: a 6-slide management pitch, “[perlu dicek]” for numbers without a source, never a price).

Then ask the agent: “Buat pitch deck untuk PT Contoso Mining Nusantara dari hasil analisis tadi.”

Fallback: if the skill upload is not available in your tenant, the strategy prompt in the 13:30 scene still returns the same six-slide outline in the chat.

Good to know about skills

  • Skills in Agent Builder agents — per Microsoft Learn, no Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on is required; up to 8 skills per agent, .zip up to 50 MB
  • Personal skills in Copilot Chat (without an agent) — Microsoft Copilot (Premium) only
  • Not available for user-built agents in tenants with Information Barriers — check with your IT team

Source: Microsoft Learn — Add skills to your declarative agent in Agent Builder; Skills in declarative agents; Build skills for Copilot Chat. Checked 24 November 2026.

Part 2 · Licences

Who can create — and use — which agent?

Your licence decides it. Click a card to trace who builds it and who can use it. Default: no pay-as-you-go set up.

1 · Agent creator
Copilot Chat (Basic) userBuilds in Agent Builder · knowledge: up to 4 public websitesCan build: Basic-capability agents
Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) userAdds work data: email, Teams, SharePoint, filesCan build: both kinds
→→
2 · The agent
Basic-capability agentInstructions + public websites, e.g. BC Market Intel Coach — you attach the file in the chatIncluded with Copilot Chat
Premium-capability agentReads the user’s own work data, e.g. a Weekly Account Recap from my email, Teams and calendarNeeds Microsoft 365 Copilot
→→
3 · Agent user
Copilot Chat (Basic) userCan use: Basic-capability agents
Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) userCan use: both kinds
✕ A Copilot Chat (Basic) user can’t use a Premium-capability agent that is shared with them — it reads work data the Basic licence doesn’t cover. Build your BC agents with instructions + public websites, and they work for every Business Consultant.

Sharing roles

  • Can edit — owner: edit, share, manage
  • Can chat — use only; groups are always Can chat
  • Org-wide or the org catalog — admin controls and approval

Rule of thumb

Agent is private after Create. Share with your team only after it passes the 6 test questions.

Source: Microsoft Learn — Purchase and manage agents in Copilot Chat; Agent capabilities and licensing models; Share and manage agents built in Agent Builder. Checked 24 November 2026.

Part 3 · Before we touch data

Four guardrails for Business Consultants

1 · Approved AI only

Work account, green shield. Customer and pricing data only in UT-approved tools, following UT data rules.

2 · No source, no number

Every figure in a pitch has a file or link behind it — or is marked “[perlu dicek]”.

3 · Facts vs assumptions

Say which is which. Rumours about competitor discounts stay out until verified.

4 · AI prepares, you decide

Prices, discounts and credit are decided by people through UT’s process.

RESEARCHER

09:00 · Reading the market with Researcher

Raka butuh gambaran pasar 6–12 bulan ke depan untuk akun prioritasnya. Researcher merencanakan riset multi-langkah, membaca sumber publik dan file dummy di OneDrive, lalu menulis laporan dengan sitasi. Hasil sudah disiapkan presenter sebelum sesi, karena Researcher bisa memerlukan 5–45 menit.

BC_Synthetic_Accounts_Fleet.csv (OneDrive · dummy)
Prompt Researcher
Saya Business Consultant alat berat untuk sektor tambang batu bara dan nikel di Kalimantan dan Sulawesi. Gunakan file /BC_Synthetic_Accounts_Fleet.csv dan sumber publik. Susun market intelligence brief 6–12 bulan ke depan untuk 4 akun dengan buying signal terkuat: (1) sinyal permintaan alat berat dari berita, kebijakan, dan laporan publik, (2) implikasi untuk peluang replacement dan expansion per akun, (3) 5 Key Intelligence Questions yang harus saya validasi ke customer. Sertakan sumber dan tanggal untuk setiap poin, dan tandai mana yang masih asumsi.
Yang ditunjukkan presenter
  • Rencana riset yang disusun Researcher sebelum mulai bekerja
  • Sinyal pasar dengan penerbit, tanggal, dan tautan — dihubungkan ke akun di file dummy
  • 5 KIQ untuk divalidasi saat kunjungan

Buka setiap sitasi sebelum memakai angka. Data akun bersifat fiktif; berita dan kebijakan berasal dari sumber publik.

Dengan Copilot Chat

Prompt yang sama dengan file terlampir memberi ringkasan singkat berbasis web — satu putaran, tanpa riset multi-langkah.

Dengan lisensi Premium

Riset multi-langkah dengan sitasi, menggabungkan web dan dokumen kerja yang dapat Anda akses; kuota 25 query Researcher per pengguna per bulan.

Watch PREMIUM · MICROSOFT 365 COPILOT · DEMO PRESENTER
ANALYST

11:00 · Setting priorities with Analyst

Dari 12 akun, mana 3–5 yang dikejar? Analyst menjalankan aturan scoring dengan Python, menampilkan chart, dan menunjukkan kodenya — sehingga setiap angka dapat diperiksa ulang. Bobot hanya contoh; UT Sales yang menentukan bobot sebenarnya.

BC_Synthetic_Accounts_Fleet.csv BC_Synthetic_Deals_WonLost.csv
Prompt Analyst
Beri skor 1-5 untuk tiap akun di file terlampir:
- Replacement need = Units_Over_15000_HM / (Our_Units + Competitor_Units): >=35% = 5, >=25% = 4, >=15% = 3, >=5% = 2, lainnya 1
- Signal = Signal_Strength_1to5
- Relationship = hari sejak Last_Engagement per 24 Nov 2026: <=30 = 5, <=60 = 4, <=90 = 3, <=180 = 2, lainnya 1
- Competitive pressure = Competitor_Units / total unit: >=60% = 5, >=45% = 4, >=30% = 3, >=15% = 2, lainnya 1
Total = 35% Replacement + 30% Signal + 20% Relationship + 15% Competitive. Urutkan, tampilkan 5 teratas dengan Validation_Status.
Jalankan perhitungan dengan Python, tampilkan kodenya, dan buat bar chart skor total. Tambahkan juga win rate per kompetitor dari file won/lost.

Tandai "[perlu dicek]" untuk angka yang belum ada sumbernya.

  • 5 · Strategi dan rencana 30-60-90 — validasi kebutuhan 27 Nov · skenario pembiayaan 2 Des · proposal 11 Des
  • 6 · Keputusan yang diperlukan — prioritas slot pengiriman dan komitmen uptime

Hands-on lab · 25 minutes

Your turn: a mini opportunity map

Start with Task C (15 minutes) — no download: press Salin prompt + data and paste into your BC Market Intel Coach or Copilot Chat. Finished early? Continue with Task A or B (10 minutes); otherwise keep them for after the session. Pick one account that is not PT Contoso Mining Nusantara. Post your result in the chat with #LAB.

Task CTryMain · 15 min

Strategy for one account

SWOT, strategi tiga kalimat, dan rencana 30-60-90.

“Untuk [akun pilihan saya], gunakan kedua file terlampir. Buat SWOT (fakta dengan sumber, asumsi diberi label), winning strategy 3 kalimat, dan rencana 30-60-90 hari dalam tabel (aktivitas, PIC, milestone, KPI). Tandai [perlu dicek] untuk yang belum ada datanya.”

Cek hasil — Litware: 55 vs 30 unit, 14 unit di atas 15.000 HM, tender armada 2027 (RFQ 10 Nov), kalah 6 dump truck karena lead time dan 3 dozer karena pembiayaan. Woodgrove: 34 vs 10 unit, 21 unit di atas 15.000 HM, tidak ada kekalahan di file deal.

Task ATryBonus · 10 min

Check & signals

Validasi data dan kelompokkan akun menjadi Retain atau Expand.

“Gunakan HANYA file akun terlampir. Cek kualitas data dan tampilkan buying signal terkuat beserta sumber dan tanggal. Kelompokkan setiap akun menjadi Retain (sudah ada unit kita) atau Expand (prospek atau area baru).”

Cek hasil: 4 akun “To verify”, 1 area kosong, 3 akun tanpa kontak lebih dari 90 hari, 4 prospek = Expand.

Task BTryBonus · 10 min

Your own scoring

Bobot Anda, 3 teratas Anda — bisakah Anda mempertahankannya?

“Beri skor akun di file terlampir dengan kriteria Replacement need, Signal, Relationship dan Competitive pressure. Pakai bobot saya: [isi bobot Anda, total 100%]. Jelaskan aturan skor 1-5 yang kamu pakai, lalu tampilkan 3 teratas beserta Validation_Status.”

Cek hasil: bobot yang berbeda menghasilkan 3 teratas yang berbeda. Apakah ada akun teratas Anda yang masih “To verify”?

Post with #LABYour top 3 and the weights you usedOne-line strategy for your chosen accountOne thing you still need to verify
Showcase · 15 minutes

Pitch your top opportunity in two minutes

Two or three BCs from the #LAB posts present; the room plays Sales Management.

You present

  • Your top 3 and why
  • Your winning strategy for one account
  • What you will do in the first 30 days

Management challenge

  • Which evidence is verified — and which is not?
  • Why now, and what would make us lose?

The best answer

“Here is what Copilot got wrong — and how I caught it.” Checking the AI is the skill we want to see.

Part 4 · A glimpse · 10 minutes

Copilot Chat helps you think. Cowork gets the work done.

Cowork delegates multi-step work across Microsoft 365 and asks for your approval before anything sensitive, such as sending an email.

Copilot ChatCopilot Cowork
Best forA quick draft, answer or insightEnd-to-end work across apps, files and data
SpeedSeconds to minutesMinutes to hours
OutputText you act onDocuments, decks and drafts — with your approval before sending
Skills—Built-in (Word, PowerPoint, Email, Meetings, Deep Research…) + your custom skills
LicenceCOPILOT CHAT · YOU CAN DO THISM365 COPILOT + USAGE BILLING · DEMO
Permintaan demo
Siapkan account review pack untuk PT Contoso Mining Nusantara: pakai notulen rapat 20 November dan file fleet di OneDrive saya, buat SWOT, susun deck 6 slide dengan skill "UT BC Pitch Deck", dan buat draft email ringkasan untuk Bu Dewi. Jangan kirim apa pun.
Rencana yang ditampilkan Cowork
  • ✓ Mencari notulen rapat 20 Nov dan file fleet
  • ✓ Menyusun SWOT — fakta dengan sumber, asumsi diberi label
  • ✓ Memuat skill UT BC Pitch Deck → membuat deck 6 slide
  • ✓ Menyusun draft email ringkasan untuk Dewi — disimpan sebagai draft, tidak dikirim
Custom skill · SKILL.md
---
name: ut-bc-pitch-deck
description: Menyusun pitch deck manajemen 6 slide untuk satu
  peluang BC. Gunakan untuk "pitch deck BC", "pitch manajemen".
  Bukan untuk proposal pelanggan atau penawaran harga.
---
1. Peluang   2. Apa kata data
3. Peta kompetisi   4. SWOT
5. Strategi + 30-60-90   6. Keputusan yang diperlukan
Aturan: angka tanpa sumber -> "[perlu dicek]";
jangan merekomendasikan harga; jangan mengirim apa pun.
How custom skills work
  • A SKILL.md file in OneDrive: Documents/Cowork/skills/<name>/ — or create it from the Customize page
  • Up to 50 custom skills; Cowork loads them automatically
  • The description decides when it fires — be specific

Source: Microsoft Learn — Copilot Cowork common questions; Get started with Copilot Cowork; Use Copilot Cowork (custom skills). Checked 24 November 2026.
